outcome: Probability of successful pregnancy with live birth
cohort: The study included 359 women (mean age, 35.9 years) with uterine fibroids and/or adenomyosis who were unable to conceive.
finding: Conventional and partial uterine fibroid embolization (UFE) were found to be safe and effective outpatient procedures for women with uterine fibroids who want to conceive, with partial UFE not increasing complication rates compared to conventional UFE.
